text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Pitter... patter...)

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
...Oh dear, a passing shower, perhaps?
I had better hurry.

text_block_list.name: Store Staff A
text_block_list.text: ――Excuse me, Umamusume miss over there!

text_block_list.name: Store Staff A
text_block_list.text:
I work at that shop over there.
We have umbrellas to lend, so please feel free to take one.
It's quite chilly today, and catching a cold would be awful.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Oh my...! 
Thank you very much!

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
You've been a huge help. It's that shop over there, right?
I will be sure to return it right away.

text_block_list.name: Store Staff A
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu, anytime is fine.
Please take care on your way home.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: Yes...!

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: Trainer, it's that shop over there.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Today, before going to buy supplies, we went to return the umbrella to the shop that had lent it to her.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: Could you wait for just a moment?

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much.
Now then...

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me.
I have come to return the umbrella I borrowed the other day.

text_block_list.name: Store Staff A
text_block_list.text: Oh, you're the one from the other day!

text_block_list.name: Store Staff A
text_block_list.text:
Or rather, I'm sorry, but...
aren't you that active racehorse—

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Yes,
my name is Victoire Pisa.

text_block_list.name: Store Staff A
text_block_list.text: That's right! Actually, one of the part-timers who knows a lot about racing told me afterward. Turns out I lent my umbrella to an incredible girl!

text_block_list.name: Store Staff A
text_block_list.text: I heard the race in Dubai was amazing. The part-timer was talking about it with so much excitement.

text_block_list.name: Store Staff A
text_block_list.text:
Keep doing your best!
I'll be cheering for you too!

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
My—fufu.
I'm so glad, thank you very much.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: Sorry to keep you waiting.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me.
Pardon me, but I borrowed an umbrella from one of the staff members here the other day—

text_block_list.name: Customer A
text_block_list.text: Wait, Victoire Pisa...!?

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Ah...
—Fufu, hello.

text_block_list.name: Customer B
text_block_list.text: I-It's the real deal—

text_block_list.name: Customer A
text_block_list.text:
Um, I saw how well you did in Dubai!
I was feeling really down back then, but seeing you helped so much.

text_block_list.name: Customer B
text_block_list.text:
M-Me too! Your success on the track
really saved me in so many ways.

text_block_list.name: Customer A
text_block_list.text: To be able to meet you and tell you this in person... It is truly an honor.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
My—you are far too kind.
The pleasure is entirely mine, thank you.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: Sorry to keep you waiting.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me.
The umbrella the other day—

text_block_list.name: Organizer
text_block_list.text: A toast, to her—!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (UOOOOOH!!)

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Oh my...! A party?
I must make my excuses and leave quickly.
Um, where might that staff member be—

text_block_list.name: Participant A
text_block_list.text: Huh!? Pisa!?

text_block_list.name: Participant B
text_block_list.text:
Eh, wha, what!?
—The real person is here!?

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
—...
The 'Victoire Pisa Appreciation Society,' you say?

text_block_list.name: Organizer
text_block_list.text:
T-That's right! In other words—
a fan-only mixer event, or something like that...!

text_block_list.name: Organizer
text_block_list.text: To think that such a miracle would actually happen!!

text_block_list.name: Participant A
text_block_list.text: I really wanted to see you, Pisa-chan...! Congratulations on your back-to-back Arima Kinen victories!

text_block_list.name: Participant A
text_block_list.text:
And about that day in Dubai, too...!
I've wanted to congratulate you in person for so long!
It was truly, truly magnificent...!

text_block_list.name: Participant C
text_block_list.text:
"I'll never forget the victory
you showed me that day!"

text_block_list.name: Organizer
text_block_list.text: A round of applause from everyone, please! For her—for the Umamusume who gave us hope!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Clap clap clap clap clap...!!)

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Oh, my...!
I'm so, so happy...!

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: Sorry to keep you waiting.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: —...Fufu.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
"...Ah, I'm sorry.
Shall we head out for some shopping?"

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: ...Fufu, yes. That's true.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Offering me an umbrella on a rainy day...
That kindness alone is something hard to come by, and yet—

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: I was even given such a heartwarming souvenir.
